title: Co-area transfer of almost-everywhere properties to almost every slice
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let μ be a measure on ℝ^P, (ν_t)_{t∈ℝ} a family of measures on ℝ^P, and w : ℝ^P → [0, ∞] any function. Assume the co-area identity: for every Borel φ : ℝ^P → [0, ∞], the function t ↦ ∫ φ dν_t is a.e.-measurable for Lebesgue measure on ℝ and ∫_ℝ (∫ φ dν_t) dt = ∫ w·φ dμ (lower Lebesgue integrals in [0, ∞]). Then for every predicate p on ℝ^P that holds μ-a.e.: for Lebesgue-a.e. t ∈ ℝ, p(x) holds for ν_t-a.e. x.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ν : ℝ → Measure (Euclid P)) (w : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞) (p : Euclid P → Prop), (∀ φ : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ → AEMeasurable (fun t => ∫⁻ x, φ x ∂(ν t)) ∧ ∫⁻ t, ∫⁻ x, φ x ∂(ν t) = ∫⁻ x, w x * φ x ∂μ) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p x) → ∀ᵐ t, ∀ᵐ x ∂(ν t), p x
